title: They Looked Awake. They Were Asleep for Three Hundred Years

meta.name: v5_k18_02_the-sleep
meta.title: They Looked Awake. They Were Asleep for Three Hundred Years

lines.text: They looked awake. They were asleep for three hundred years.
Inside the cave, the young men sleep.
And you would think them awake, while they were asleep. And We turned them to the right and to the left, while their dog stretched his forelegs at the entrance.

quran.ar: وَتَحۡسَبُهُمۡ أَیۡقَاظࣰا وَهُمۡ رُقُودࣱۚ وَنُقَلِّبُهُمۡ ذَاتَ ٱلۡیَمِینِ وَذَاتَ ٱلشِّمَالِۖ وَكَلۡبُهُم بَـٰسِطࣱ ذِرَاعَیۡهِ بِٱلۡوَصِیدِۚ

lines.text: And they remained in their cave for three hundred years and exceeded by nine.

quran.ar: وَلَبِثُوا۟ فِی كَهۡفِهِمۡ ثَلَـٰثَ مِا۟ئَةࣲ سِنِینَ وَٱزۡدَادُوا۟ تِسۡعࣰا

lines.text: Still, Allāh turned them to the right and left.
Even asleep, they were not forgotten.
